title: Implement Score Board and LocalStorage High Score Management
description: Create a scoring system that tracks current score, updates on asteroid destruction, and persists high scores using browser LocalStorage. Include unit tests for score calculation and storage persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Score increases correctly based on asteroid size tier
High scores are correctly saved to and retrieved from LocalStorage
reviewFeedback: The implementation is clean, modular, correctly handles LocalStorage interaction with appropriate fallbacks, and includes comprehensive unit tests verifying scoring and persistence.
